testResults.name: reference-strategy-integration
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/integration -q
testResults.result: 6 tests passed over a small two-symbol (SPY + QQQ) fixture driven through the real backtest runner: buy-and-hold enters one position per symbol and holds, intraday momentum is flat at every session close with byte-identical artifacts across repeated runs, and mean reversion exercises cancellation, replacement, and partial fills.

testResults.name: ci-fixture
testResults.result: All three strategies run in a single combined runner execution over the packaged fixture; the suite runs in every pytest invocation, including CI.

testResults.name: sandbox-and-focused-quality
testResults.result: All example sources pass assert_sandbox_clean and the repository Ruff lint/format and ty checks; strategies use only context-injected capabilities with no wall-clock, unseeded random, network, or I/O access.

decisions: Momentum reads session closes from configuration and liquidates through context.clock before each close, so the same class is configuration-driven rather than hard-coded.
strategies.harness_examples ships in the runtime wheel via the repository packaging configuration, making module:Class implementation paths resolvable by the runner and CLI.
limitations: Mean reversion exposes a module-level instance registry so integration tests can observe cancel/replace lifecycle without changing the runner contract.
